title: Exponentials and Logarithms
learning_objectives: Use the rules log(ab) = log a + log b and log_b x = ln x / ln b
Avoid underflow by adding log-probabilities instead of multiplying probabilities
Compute log-sum-exp stably by subtracting the maximum
hints: Loop over the probabilities, check `0 < p <= 1`, and add `math.log(p)`.
`m = max(values)`, then `m + math.log(sum(math.exp(v - m) for v in values))`.

failure_feedback.advice: Add logs one by one instead of taking the log of the product.
Raise ValueError for any p that is not in (0, 1].
Subtract the maximum before exponentiating and add it back after the log.
